ModMetaData.name: Perspective Shift - Captivity
ModMetaData.author: astryl
ModMetaData.description: Start a Perspective Shift run as a lone captive held inside a hostile faction's settlement. You begin with almost no agency: confined, restrained, and watched. Captors can discipline you, sell you to new owners, and harass you, and you must earn or force your way to freedom. Fully SFW. Requires Perspective Shift and Harmony.
